contexts.text: A vine, in the Word, = Spiritual good.
That the Lord instructed them in Spiritual good and in natural good. Signified.
Therefore by an organ is signified Spiritual good.
Spiritual good inflows with the spiritual man.
Milk = spiritual good. AC 2967:9.
When man is being reformed and regenerated, spiritual good is insinuated by the Lord, and what is worldly is tempered by it...
Truth from good is spiritual good. (Fully Explained under Celestial good.)
Natural good is little relatively to spiritual good; and this is less relatively to celestial good. Representation.
To dwell is predicated of the good of truth, or of spiritual good, that is, of the good of the spiritual man. Illustrated.
Spiritual good after regeneration, Treated of.
Flock of Kedar = spiritual good.
Arabia = spiritual good.
The things taken by hunting, as rams, kids, she-goats, = spiritual goods.
Israel is essentially the first-born, that is, spiritual good.
Bread = the good of truth; for this is spiritual good.
Into this interior speech comes the man... who is in spiritual good, that is, in the good of faith, or, what is the same, in charity towards the neighbour, while he lives here.
See Natural good. AC 3504.
Truths of good, which are spiritual goods. Signified.
Truths from the good of love to the Lord are the goods of charity themselves, which are called spiritual goods. Signified.
Israel = celestial truth, or spiritual good.
(Use of collateral good in procuring spiritual good.)
In  it treats of the conjunction of natural truth, through mediums, with spiritual good.
A regenerate man is in spiritual good itself.
Drum, and harp, are predicated of spiritual good... Spiritual good is what is called the good of faith; and is charity. AC 8337.
Every spiritual good has its own truths...
Vir homo = spiritual good, or the good of truth.

By good is meant spiritual good, which good, in the Word, is called charity; and this good in general consists in willing and doing good to another from no selfish reason, but from the delight of affection. This good is spiritual good; and to this no man can ever come except through the truths of faith. (Continued. See Good of Truth.)
Libation = the good of truth, or spiritual good.
Noble vine = spiritual good.
Reuben = spiritual good, which is the same as the good of faith, such as is in the Second Heaven.
Moon = spiritual good, or truth.
That it would teach Divine spiritual goods. Signified, Explained.
Scarlet, and double-dyed = spiritual good, that is, the good of charity towards the neighbour. Illustrated.
When in the work of conjunction with spiritual good in the Natural. Signified.
By the Hebrew servant is meant spiritual truth and good, which, here is Joseph. Example(s).
By Joseph in the prison house is described the temptation of spiritual good in the Natural.
Clusters = the truth of spiritual good. Illustrated.
Manasseh = spiritual good in the Natural, thus the new Voluntary.
That there was conjunction also with spiritual good. Signified, Explained.
Their father (Israel) = spiritual good.
The quality of truths unless conjoined with spiritual good. Signified.
To be separated from spiritual good. Signified.

For the truth of faith which is of doctrine, as soon as it enters the will, becomes the truth of life, and becomes truth in act, and is then called good, and also becomes spiritual good. From this good there is formed by the Lord a new will; which will causes truth to be good. Explained.
Perception from spiritual good. Signified. AC 5616.

The internal Spiritual Church is a Church from spiritual good. Spiritual good is truth which has been made good; for truth becomes good when the man lives according to it; for it then passes into the will, and from the will into act, and becomes of life; and, when truth becomes of life, it is no longer called truth, but good. But the will which transforms truth into good is the new will in the intellectual part. This good is what is called spiritual good. Spiritual good is distinguished from celestial good by this: that celestial good was implanted in the voluntary part itself.
Spiritual good from which are the truths of faith. Signified.
That it was well with spiritual good. Signified.
Spiritual good is called father, because from it as a father are the truths and goods in the Natural.
Under Israel, see this reference.
Elevation to spiritual good. Signified.
In the interior Natural is the spiritual good which is Israel.
That spiritual good would perish, and thus the internal of the Church... if the truth represented by Benjamin perished. Signified, Explained. AC 5837.

As (the internal man cannot conjoin himself with the external natural) except through spiritual good from the Natural, which is Israel, he first prepares to adjoin that good to himself. Treated of. AC 5879.
That spiritual good is the father of the celestial Internal, although spiritual good is relatively external because from the Natural. Explained.
Spiritual good and all things from it, and all things from these again (conjoined with the celestial Internal). Signified, Explained.
The communication of the Spiritual Heaven in the Natural, with spiritual good. Signified, Explained.
The good in which the spiritual are, is called spiritual good... and spiritual good is the good of love towards the neighbour.
Spiritual good, which is charity. Signified.
The accession of spiritual good, and of the truths of the Church, to the scientifics of the Natural. Signified, Explained.
What is given gratis to spiritual good, Signified, Explained.
Interior truth for spiritual good in the meanwhile. Signified, Explained.
Whether you say spiritual good, or the internal of the Church, it is the same... for spiritual good constitutes the internal of the Church.
In  it treats of the conjunction of the celestial Internal (Joseph) with spiritual good from the Natural (Israel).
For all spiritual goods are of charity towards the neighbour.
Influx from the celestial Internal into spiritual good from the natural. Signified. AC 6082. AC 6106.
The perception of spiritual good from the celestial Internal. Signified.
In  it treats, finally, of the regeneration of spiritual good from the Natural, which is Israel.
For spiritual good, which is represented by Israel, is the good of truth.
For works... are what are called spiritual goods...
The life of spiritual good and of the truths of the Church from the celestial Internal. Signified.
The Intellectual is... the recipient of spiritual truth and good...
That spiritual good world live among the scientifics of the Church. Signified.
In the relative sense, Isaac = spiritual good.
That natural truth, which is Jacob, should be elevated to spiritual good, which is Israel. Signified.
New forces through spiritual good. Signified, Explained.
That spiritual good should turn itself to the things which are of the interior Natural. Signified, Explained.
That (the Intellectual and Voluntary of the Church) should accede to spiritual good. Signified.

That the spiritual good which is represented by Israel is in obscure perception; for it is from the Natural, where natural lumen dominates, and not the heavenly light in which is the spiritual and celestial good which is from the Rational. Signified.
When spiritual good from the Natural is mentioned, those are meant who are in this good, namely, those who are of the Lord's Spiritual Church.
That the celestial Internal removed the good of the Voluntary, and the truth of the Intellectual, from spiritual good, that is, from the affection of love thereof. Signified, Explained.
That the celestial Internal (Joseph) saw that spiritual good from the Natural (Israel) was in error. Signified, Explained.

Still, this truth (in which the spiritual have faith, whether it is true or not) becomes good with them, when it becomes of the will, and thence of the life, and it is then that good which is called the good of truth, the good of faith, and also spiritual good, or the good of the Spiritual Church. The quality of the good which is from such an origin may thus be seen. But still, good from such truth, even with the Gentiles, is accepted by the Lord, when it has charity towards the neighbour as its principle, and in this charity there is innocence.

When spiritual good is in illumination by virtue of influx from the celestial Internal, it apperceives that... good is in the prior place, and truth in the posterior... but it then places the priority in this: that truth must reign above good. Signified.
(For) the spiritual good which is represented by Israel is the Spiritual of the internal Church, whereas the truth and good which are represented by Ephraim and Manasseh are of the external Church.
The perception of spiritual good from the celestial Internal concerning the new life, and concerning the end of the representation. Signified, Explained.
A prediction concerning (the truths and goods in the Natural) by spiritual good. Signified, Explained.
That (faith alone) contaminated spiritual good in the Natural. Signified, Explained.
That spiritual good did not want to know the evils which were of their will. Signified, Explained.
That the Spiritual Church has spiritual good from the Natural. Signified, Explained.
Communication (with all truths and goods) through influx from spiritual good. Signified, Explained.
It here treats of the gathering together or manifestation of the spiritual good which is Israel in natural goods and truths which are his sons or the tribes named from them. Fully explained.
The influx of the Internal into the affection of spiritual good. Signified, Explained.
For this good to come forth, there must be an influx from the celestial Internal...
See Good of Charity.
The distinction between spiritual good and natural good. Fully explained. See Natural good.
See Good of Truth. AC 8521:2.
Soul is predicated of spiritual good.
For spiritual good receives its quality from the truths of faith.

All spiritual good proceeds either from faith, that is, through faith, or from love. While man is being regenerated, the good with him proceeds from the truth of faith. Explained... But afterwards, when he has been regenerated, he does good from affection, thus from love.
Under Bread, see this reference. AC 8464.
(Thus) man cannot be endowed with spiritual good... unless he desists from evils.
Palm trees = spiritual good, or the good of truth. Illustrated.

The manna = spiritual good. And that this is given by the Lord continually, without any care or strength of theirs, is signified by their receiving the manna daily, and that if they gathered more, it bred worms. AC 8413:2.
It is the state of morning there when spiritual good, or that of the internal man, is in clearness.
Cake = spiritual good.

Spiritual good is here described, whence and how it comes forth, and thus its quality; namely, that this good in its first origin is truth, and that it becomes good from the fact that, from the will, thus from affection, it comes into act; for whatever man wills from affection is apperceived as good. But this good cannot come forth except through delights which are of the natural man; through these the spiritual man is introduced; and, when he has been introduced, he has thence a sense of it. Signified.
A kingdom of priests = here, spiritual good, which is the good of truth; that is, the good into which the man of the Spiritual Church is introduced through truth.

All Christian good, or spiritual good, has in it the truths of faith; for the quality of this good is from the truths which are of faith. The good which has not its quality from the truths of faith is not Christian good, but is natural good, which does not confer eternal life...
An extension into Heaven no further than to the spiritual spheres of good. Signified, Explained. AC 8837.
For the sons of Israel, who are here the people = those who are in spiritual good in which truth is to be implanted.
That spiritual good also would perish. Signified.
There is a general perception with those who are in spiritual good; and they can receive a general influx of the good of a higher Heaven; here, of the Inmost Heaven. Signified.
That those in spiritual good, in which the Divine is, should be protected as to the interiors. Signified, Explained.
Lest those in spiritual good and truth should desire to ascend into the Celestial Heaven. Signified.
For the good with man is not spiritual good until it has been formed by truths; but, when it has been formed, there is the heavenly marriage...
That his spiritual goods are not to be taken away from anyone. Signified, Explained.
Maidservant = the affection of spiritual good.

For spiritual good is good not for the sake of gain or honour; but for the sake of the Church and the salvation of the neighbour. Such good cannot be conjoined with those who are in the externals of the Church; for it is the good of charity itself, and springs from the affection which is of love. Signified.

The law from which this statute flows is that spiritual good cannot be conjoined with those who are in the externals of the Church from infancy, but only adjoined so long as they are in combat; and that, after combat, it recedes. Explained.
The delight of the remembrance of spiritual goods. Signified, Explained.
See Spiritual Truth.
Good conjoined with truth is what is meant by spiritual good; and therefore when truth perishes with man, good perishes also; and vice versa...
Vineyard = the Spiritual Church, thus spiritual good, which is the good of charity towards the neighbour; for this good makes the Spiritual Church.
Sons of Israel from the land of Egypt = those who have been initiated into spiritual truths and goods through scientific truths.
The glory of Lebanon, or the cedar = spiritual good and truth.
Silver = spiritual good, which is the good of faith in the Lord and of charity towards the neighbour.
The cedar of Shittah = spiritual good.

(These precious stones) = spiritual truths and goods in general... For the stones of fillings were for the breastplate, and by the breastplate upon the ephod was signified the good of faith, or spiritual good.
The lungs = spiritual good.

Scarlet double-dyed = spiritual good, or the good of truth... In such an order follow... the truths and goods with a man and Angel in the Second Heaven. First there is truth from a celestial origin (fine linen); then the love or affection of truth (hyacinthine); afterwards, the derivative love, or affection of good (crimson); and, finally, spiritual good (scarlet double-dyed).
The good of faith in Him is called spiritual good.
This Divine good becomes spiritual good through the reception of Divine truth, as of light from the moon. Signified.
The appropriation of spiritual good with those who are in internals from the Lord. Signified, Explained.
Spiritual good from what is celestial sufficient for conjunction. Signified, Explained.
Fine flour = here, truth from celestial good, which truth is called spiritual good.
Cedar = spiritual good, which is charity towards the neighbour.
(The anointing of) the table = the Divine of the Lord in spiritual good which is from what is celestial, which is of the Second Heaven. Explained.
Which are fragrant = affections from spiritual good.
Pure frankincense = inmost truth, which is spiritual good. Explained.
As the man of the (Ancient) Church was in spiritual good, which good is in its essence truth, those times were called the Silver Age; for silver = such good.

At this day there is no faith because there is no charity; and, where there is no charity, there is no spiritual good; for this good is solely from charity. I have been told from Heaven that there is still good with some, but that this cannot be called spiritual good, but natural good, because Divine truths themselves are in obscurity, and Divine truths introduce to charity... Hence it is that there is no spiritual good at this day, but, with some, only natural good. TCR 754.

There are civil good, moral good, and spiritual good... Spiritual good is that which man does from spiritual law. Through this good, and according to it, is a man a citizen in the Spiritual World. These goods follow in this order: spiritual good is the highest...

The man who has spiritual good is a moral and also a civil man; but the man who has not spiritual good, appears as if he were a moral and civil man, but is not... For spiritual good has an essence of good in it... DLife 14.
Confession of the Lord's Divine Human from spiritual goods. Signified, Explained. AE 324.
Frankincense = spiritual good. AE 491:5.
Spiritual good, which in its essence is truth, and is signified, in special, by the kidneys, is exterior good; but celestial good, which is signified in special by the heart, is interior good.

The Second Heaven consists of those who are in spiritual good, or in the good of charity towards the neighbour; and, as celestial good is good in the highest place, and spiritual good is good in the second place, therefore the latter is around the former.
Feathers with yellow of gold = spiritual good from which are these truths.
What is meant by worship from spiritual good Explained.
Wine = spiritual good, which is the good of charity towards the neighbour, and the good of faith; and this good in its essence is truth. Explained. AE 376:4, Illustrated.
Israel = spiritual good, which is truth from celestial good.
The three tribes of Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh = those things which fully constitute spiritual good.

a. 2. When the Heavens are more interiorly and closely conjoined with the Lord, those are separated with whom there is not any spiritual good; for spiritual good alone conjoins, and not any natural good which does not derive its essence... from spiritual good. Explained.

Spiritual good is formed by the Lord with man through truths and a life according to them; whereas external good separated from internal spiritual good is formed through a moral life which has self and the world as its end...
The conjunction of celestial good with spiritual good, and thus the conjunction of the higher Heavens. Signified, Explained.
The incensings represented worship from spiritual good.
Spiritual good is formed with man through truths; for the truth with him becomes spiritual good when he lives according to it; and therefore spiritual good in its essence is truth. AE 831:4.
The right hand = spiritual good, which is truth in light; and the left hand = spiritual truth, which is truth in shade...
This truth from good in its essence is spiritual good; for this good, in its form, is truth from good. Signified.
When these falsities from evil are removed, then, for the first time, truths from good, or spiritual good, inflows from the Lord, and is received by man. Signified.
Both the firstfruits, and the firstborn = the spiritual good first formed, which in itself is the truth from good which is from the Lord. Explained.
Charity, or spiritual good, is to do good because it is truth, thus it is to do truth...
For spiritual good is from the Lord, and moral good is from man...
These have not any spiritual good; and this good, which is the good of charity from the Lord, alone opens the spiritual mind...
A tree from a grain of mustard seed = the man of the Church, and also the Church, which begins from a little spiritual good through truth...
